finding: Client-folder write protection knows only the default packages folder plus store and registered folders; a custom install location (Steam, Program Files, custom packages or assets override) is not recognized.
suggestion: Detect the actual client folder from the active location settings and include it.

finding: Sprite extraction (unless Skip existing), sound extraction and map tile extraction write without OutputSession, so existing files are overwritten without asking and without backup.
Synchronous I/O on the UI thread: Clients page refresh reads every manifest twice and enumerates store objects; Rebuilder plan; start-up source inspection and hashing in Ask mode.
suggestion: Move to Task.Run and cache usage figures.

finding: ItemCatalogStore.Commit validates mapping source IDs after the snapshot is written.
BackupSet.Add(move: true) across volumes deletes the original before checking the copy hash.
app.manifest assemblyIdentity version is 5.0.0.0; Portable.pubxml hard-codes 8.0.0 in PublishDir.
Six commands have no UI binding (OpenClientFolder, OpenSettings in Diagnostics, RefreshCatalogs, RotateLeft/Right, ThemeColorRow.Select).
Three async void methods; AppearancesViewModel.UpdateDetails has no try/catch (falls back to the global handler).
Plain HTTP endpoints: test-server asset base (mitigated by hash check on download) and a credit link.
suggestion: Use HTTPS where the server supports it.

finding: ClientStorageMode is a string instead of an enum.
AppLog keeps at most 1000 pending lines; DiagnosticsCollector MaxLogBytes counts characters, not bytes.
NumericUpDown adds button Click handlers again when its template is reapplied.
Two types named CatalogEntry (Core.Editing and Core.Items).
AppearanceGifBuilder ping-pong frames may not form grids for grid effects.
suggestion: Add a test with a grid effect.

finding: Several existing docs carry old version numbers in their titles (6.0, 7.0, 7.0.1, 7.1).
The unpacked portable release folder contains runtime data created after the zip; the zip has only the program.
suggestion: Remove the data folder or re-extract.

finding: AtomicFile does not flush to disk before replacing; StoreFiles.CopyIn does.
suggestion: Flush with FileStream.Flush(true) for settings and catalogs.
